_notes: Loop reads this each tick. No readable usage signal, so the loop ASKS the operator for current Claude usage every usage_checkin_every_ticks ticks (or when last_usage is stale) and maps the answer via usage_to_mode. conserve = skip UI + reaper gate, local-only verify, longer cadence; pause = stop scheduling (detached bot plays solo). Never block if unanswered - proceed on the last known mode. When a reset time is given, wake just after it.
